say:2:1241116001:1.source_cn: 主人，漫漫，你们有看到吗？

say:3:1241116002:1.text: The villagers of Brineville are super strong, with bulging muscles. Chippy is so envious!
say:3:1241116002:1.source_cn: 小水村的村民们，力气都特别大，身上隐隐约约还能看到肌肉...

choice_prompt:4:1241116002.text: The villagers of Brineville are super strong, with bulging muscles. Chippy is so envious!
choice_prompt:4:1241116002.source_cn: 小水村的村民们，力气都特别大，身上隐隐约约还能看到肌肉！满满好羡慕！

say:5:1241116003:1.text: Indeed, the women of Brineville are completely different from those in other places.
say:5:1241116003:1.source_cn: 是呀，小水村里的女性和其他地方的完全不一样。

say:6:1241116004:1.text: Having traveled so much, we've rarely seen women who can swap between a rake in the fields and a sword against their enemies in the blink of an eye.
say:6:1241116004:1.source_cn: 我们旅行过这么多地方，很少有日常耕作的女性会像她们一样...

say:7:1241116005:1.source_cn: 这样的勇气，真让人钦佩！

say:9:1241116007:1.text: When the Water Wights were retreating with Tesio, Chippy saw several villagers trying to catch up and stop them, completely ignoring their own wounds.
say:9:1241116007:1.source_cn: 水鬼帮带着泰西欧撤离的时候，满满还看到有好几位村民都想...

say:10:1241116008:1.text: If it weren't for the sheer numbers of the Water Wights and the many villagers who were injured, Tesio might not have escaped!
say:10:1241116008:1.source_cn: 要不是水鬼帮人多势众，太多村民受了伤，或许泰西欧都逃不出去！

choice_prompt:11:1241116008.text: If it weren't for the sheer numbers of the Water Wights and the many villagers who were injured, Tesio might not have escaped!
choice_prompt:11:1241116008.source_cn: 要不是水鬼帮人多势众，太多村民受了伤，或许泰西欧都逃不出去！

say:12:1241116009:1.text: That's right… After their husbands went missing, they struggled just to earn a living while bearing the weight of so much scorn. Just thinking about it is exhausting.
say:12:1241116009:1.source_cn: 没错……她们的丈夫失踪后，她们不仅要想办法赚钱养家，还...

say:13:1241116010:1.text: But to survive and protect their remaining loved ones, they've had no choice but to force themselves to be strong.
say:13:1241116010:1.source_cn: 但为了生存下去，为了守护还在身边的亲人，她们只能强迫自...

say:14:1241116011:1.text: In spite of everything, they've never given up fighting or let go of their hatred.
say:14:1241116011:1.source_cn: 但即使是在这种情况下，她们也从来没有放弃过反抗、忘记过仇恨。

say:15:1241116012:1.text: Will there ever come a day when they'll discover the truth they've yearned for and vindicate their families from years of wrongdoings...
say:15:1241116012:1.source_cn: 不知道将来会不会有一天，她们能等来梦寐以求的真相，替她...

choice:11:0:1.text: The power of hatred is potent.
choice:11:0:1.source_cn: 仇恨的力量是很强大的
choice:11:0:1.male: The power of hatred is potent.
choice:11:0:1.female: The power of hatred is potent.

choice:4:0:1.text: A testament to their hard work.
choice:4:0:1.male: A testament to their hard work.
choice:4:0:1.female: A testament to their hard work.

choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 她们有着强大的内心和力量
